summary: html-portfolio@origin/main (3a92179, 2026-08-25) is the Meera/Maya companion's engine: a 'RelationalOS' of pure client-bundle TypeScript (src/engine) plus plain-JS Vercel functions (api/) over Neon SQL-over-HTTP. What it built: (1) a pure context compiler with a byte-stable CORE and a TAIL of typed slots T1-T16 with budgets, drop priorities and whole-block drops, per-slot byte telemetry, byte-identity against a frozen oracle (83/83), and a fixture-driven budget gate; (2) persona-as-module (AgentModule + 29-field CharacterSheet), proven with a second agent, Kabir (412/412 invariants across 2 agents); (3) a cited memory graph (vy_episode log spans, vy_fact with a citation CHECK and bi-temporal belief change, vy_pattern promoted by a generated column, halfvec exact-scan embeddings, an RRF-fused Hinglish recall that raised recall@8 from 73.9% to 95.7%); (4) consolidation where the model may cite only by index, a 5% cross-family entailment audit that halts at >2% refuted, anchored importance, and an hourly cron behind an env switch and a kill switch; (5) relationship state with asymmetric hysteresis (honorific needs >=3 episodes over >=7 days, trust limited to +/-0.05/day, repair needs the user's signal, a rupture record kept apart from a stance that lapses); (6) an emotional interior with charter G1-G8 (feeling fused with cause, 9h half-life, never reads usage, no UI, no accumulating mood) and authored pull-only taste (self-consistency 27% to 63%); (7) an output-side honesty gate (provenance allowlist for identifiers, receipt and commitment ledgers computed from the transcript, a streaming guard) that cut the receipt leak from 1/8 to 0 with 29/29 clean replies byte-identical; (8) age-tier frozen minor gates and an app-voiced session clock; (9) privacy and tenancy as WHERE-clause predicates before rank (0 of 31,122 leaks vs 57-98% for prompt rules); (10) a turn trace and telemetry that store references, not copies; (11) process tooling (context graph with a two-way --check, verify-release by exit code, CI evals, negative controls inside each run). How far it got: it shipped, but the derived layer was empty in production until 2026-08-21 because the crons lived on a non-default branch. After that, 25 rel_state rows and 446 cited facts at $0.00092 cash. Open: relationship-stance survival across model swaps is NOT CLAIMED, the realtime lane has no output gate, and the powered judged memory battery is blocked on judge qualification (every zero-cash judge failed; the trusted judge self-agrees only 77.1%). For Taxila: copy the OS mechanisms and the gates, rewrite the persona as TeacherSheets, invert the adult-default age mapping (all learners are minors), and build covert comprehension, the learning profile and generated modules on the observation/pattern/arc and ActivityState seams. Its rejections log (77 entries harvested) is the most valuable part.

Every optional bundle (relBundle/selfBundle/roomBundle/activity/ageGates/agent) renders 0 bytes when absent. A sections byte map is tracked during assembly, alongside hashCore (FNV-1a, isomorphic), hashManifest and assertManifestArithmetic.

assets.title: Nightly consolidation with citation enforcement
assets.what: Index-only citations (writer window). Facts citing a rejected episode are rejected. 5% cross-family entailment audit halts at >2% refuted (n>=5). Anchored importance vs 3 exemplars. Contradiction = new row + supersede. need_p decay. Forget suppression. Kin need verbatim evidence. Trust/repair: LLM decides presence with citations, code decides magnitude, the same evidence may not move trust twice. Patterns <=2/night. Phrases >=3 distinct days. Watch rows excluded. runFullChainForPerson runs the six steps.

Production census: meera_log 2,358 rows / 41 devices, vy_person 40, vy_episode 2, vy_fact 8, vy_rel_state 0, all derived tables 0. Scheduled workflow runs ever: 0.
Full-population enrichment: 133 episodes, 295 facts, 446 embeddings, cash $0.00092. Projection 78k tokens vs 75,819 actual (within 3%). Azure fallback 2.2%.

measurements.claim: vy_rel_state 0 -> 25 rows. Production recall now returns relState (11 keys), texture bands, phrases. Self-layer wiring gate 37/37 with 6/6 negative controls.
measurements.method: committed cron flags run by hand

measurements.claim: Trusted judge claude-opus-4.8 agrees with itself 74/96 = 77.1% [67.7,84.4], below the 80% qualification bar.
Zero-cash judges vs archived verdicts: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 27.4%, gpt-5.6-terra 52.1%, grok-4.3 34.4%. All fail. Slot-A bias 58-81%.
On byte-identical input the judged fabrication rate spread 13.6pp (median |diff| 28pp, one cell 50% -> 92%). Any claim at n<300 is noise.
Retuned watch directive: engagement 20.4% -> 41.7% with fabrication +1.0pp [-3.1,+5.1] (no detected rise).
Same Foundry deployment's engagement shifted in 4 days (before-arm 20.4% -> 7.9% -> 7.3%).
Turn trace adds 0 SQL statements to recall, +593 B response, ~0.5us per event (~4us/turn), 4,456 B stored per turn.
Resilience ladder: fast 502 -> retry -> 200 = 778ms. Every key slow-502 held the 4000ms deadline (4203ms total). Quota on every key took 253ms.
Google TTS preview first frame degraded to 9.7-11.3s vs 615-1051ms healthy. A 1400ms fuse caused a total outage. A two-phase fuse restored 200 at ~13s.
Shared research/production key exhausted ($25.02 of $25) took production chat down (all 9 free keys 429 + OpenRouter exhausted).
Noise-robust barge-in: ONSET_CONFIRM 250ms, duty 0.6 (one step from a cliff). Self-interruption at -3dB 1/8 -> 0/8. Self-duck 68% -> 30%.
Romanised-Hinglish cascade TTS: bare 'hai' round-trips as 'hi'; 'chhod' -> 'chod' (aspiration loss).
Same voice name on the live vs TTS model: pitch -0.32 semitone (not the difference). Spectral tilt +4.4dB, but within-TTS spread is 10.1dB.
Free Gemini pool real daily ceiling ~75 calls (9 keys). The fresh incumbent itself emits Devanagari 1/74.
Research sweep: 23 agents, 12 load-bearing claims adversarially verified (5 confirmed, 6 corrected, 1 killed).
Second agent composed from the same core: 412/412 invariant checks across 2 agents. Maya byte-identical 83/83 through 5 extraction batches.

concepts.name: Structure beats instruction
concepts.description: If a property is decidable from the bytes, decide it on the bytes. Prompt rules leaked 57-98%, a SQL predicate leaked 0/31,122.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child safety, PII, parent disclosure and honesty become predicates and WHERE clauses.

concepts.name: The prompt sets a ceiling; the model decides how close you get
concepts.description: Byte-identical prompts on different models lost 38-2 or doubled turn length.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Select gpt-5.6/gpt-realtime-2.1 configs by blind batteries and deterministic register axes.

concepts.name: Shapes, never lines
concepts.description: Anything sentence-shaped in a prompt gets recited. Write telegraphic notes.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Lesson content, praise and examples in prompts must be shapes.

concepts.name: Position is mechanism
concepts.description: Last-appended rules fire, mid-brief ones do not. The last slot is capped at two.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Choose Taxila's two last-slot rules empirically.

concepts.name: Pull-only memory
concepts.description: Recall surfaces only when the current turn pulls it (deixis, query match), with labels saying 'never raise unprompted'.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Bring up past struggles only when the child or the occasion pulls them.

concepts.name: Record vs stance
concepts.description: Permanent cited event history, with a derived per-turn stance that lapses (rupture 21d/8 warm; thread 9h).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Past frustration stays on record. The teacher's posture resets.

concepts.name: Feeling fused with its cause
concepts.description: Interior state stores one sentence that is both feeling and cause, so no mood can exist without its cause in context.
concepts.taxila_relevance: The teacher's emotional OS never invents a cause for a mood.

concepts.name: G1 content-vs-usage test
concepts.description: A feature is CONTENT if computable from one utterance with no outside timestamp. Otherwise USAGE. Usage may never write the agent's feelings.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Usage may inform the learner model but never the teacher's affect or guilt-shaped lines.

concepts.name: Input starvation as guarantee
concepts.description: Extractors are not shown timestamps or usage, so they cannot misuse them.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learner-affect extractors decide on content only.

concepts.name: Coarse bands, never numbers
concepts.description: Render derived state as bands (trust: building/steady), never raw scalars.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Mastery rendered as bands in prompts and parent views.

concepts.name: Citation law
concepts.description: No derived row without citations to source episodes. Enforced by CHECK, writer window, entailment audit and orphan sweep.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Every learning-profile claim cites evidence.

concepts.name: Observation vs pattern vs arc
concepts.description: One citation recalls. >=2 citations and >=3 support across >=2 days generalizes. >=3 citations spanning >=42 days claims growth.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Staged confidence for 'how this child learns' and 'how they have improved'.

concepts.name: Told ledger (anti-join)
concepts.description: Track what was already told to whom. Render only the untold.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Never re-explain the same analogy as new.

concepts.name: Agent-scoped vs relationship-scoped state
concepts.description: State of the agent is global. State of the relationship is per person.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher persona facts global. Child disclosures per child.

concepts.name: A channel is a transport, not a relationship
concepts.description: Chat, call and watch share one compiler and state. Only rendering differs.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Voice lesson, text, and modules form one continuous relationship.

concepts.name: A slot is wired when a real prompt contains its bytes
concepts.description: Verify delivery by compiled output with real rows, not by declared status.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Lane-parity and per-slot byte telemetry from day one.

concepts.name: Anything that checks the system must be checked by the system
concepts.description: Guards, workflows and indexes are themselves tested, with negative controls in-run.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Taxila's gates must be wired into CI and break-tested.

concepts.name: Fail toward safety
concepts.description: Unknown tier -> minor gates. Clock reconciliation takes MAX. A missing gate bundle fails closed.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Default every uncertain state to the child-safe branch.

concepts.name: Absence is the safe default and the hidden danger
concepts.description: Additive seams render 0 bytes when absent (safe landing) but hide missing producers forever.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Pair every additive seam with a presence assertion.

concepts.name: A sliced block is a lie
concepts.description: Drop whole facts or blocks, never truncate mid-fact. Truncation eats the end, where safety text sits.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Prompt budget gates for long lesson tails.

concepts.name: Reason-contingent proactivity
concepts.description: The agent may initiate only because something happened, never because the user was silent.
concepts.taxila_relevance: No absence-triggered nudges to children.

concepts.name: Gamify without the lever
concepts.description: Celebrate real progression at fixed magnitude. No variable reward, streak anxiety or fake urgency. Celebration only in game mode.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Gamification for minors under DPDP no-addictive-design.

concepts.name: Pre-registration
concepts.description: Freeze fixtures, rubrics and acceptance rules by hash before judged runs. Arms are builds.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Covert-comprehension evals pre-registered before tuning.

concepts.name: Judges are unreliable on code-switched affect
concepts.description: Six frontier judges failed qualification. The trusted judge self-agrees 77.1%.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Use human raters and deterministic axes for child speech quality.

concepts.name: One writer per mirror set
concepts.description: When a constant must live in several runtimes, one script writes all of them and verifies.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Voice/model/persona constants across web, Android and serverless.

concepts.name: Identity in cache keys
concepts.description: Anything persisted across a config change carries that config in its key.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generated module/audio caches keyed by model, voice and persona version.

concepts.name: Lifecycle matrix as code
concepts.description: Every event x context cell names its carrier and a written why, or the build fails.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Lesson-state transitions (module start/end, call drop, parent join).
